newsitem.title: USA: Long Beach IPO cuts price range again.
newsitem.headline: Long Beach IPO cuts price range again.

text.p: The estimated price range for the initial public offering in Long Beach Financial Corp was reduced to a target price of $6.50 from a range of $8 to $9, lead underwriter Friedman Billings Ramsey & Co Inc said on Thursday.

The original estimate for the initial public offering's price range was $10 to $12. The initial public offering, expected to trade on Friday under the proposed symbol "LBFC" on the Nasdaq National Market, retained the proposed number of shares at 21.75 million shares.
Long Beach deals with sub-prime mortgage originators.
